references.text: Warning against being tempted to worship the host of heaven and other gods, the same theme of apostasy from the Lord.
Warning about the consequences of forgetting the Lord and following other gods.
The same warning to guard your heart so it is not led astray into worshipping other gods.
Warning against being enticed to serve other gods, with a focus on the condition of the heart.
Prohibition against serving and worshipping other gods, the sun, the moon, or the host of heaven.
Warning against those who turn away from the Lord to serve the gods of other peoples.
The first commandment forbidding having other gods and worshipping them.
Joshua's warning that the Lord will turn against the people if they abandon Him and serve foreign gods.
The people's apostasy by burning incense to other gods, which led to judgment.
Warning against having an evil and unbelieving heart that turns away from the living God.
